name: iso-recorder
description: Records one file per source while you stream, independent of the composite program output.
long_description: An OBS Studio plugin that records each armed source on its own while you stream. Picture sources are written to a per-source file and audio-only sources to a 24-bit WAV, independent of the composite program output. A dock owns the session: tick sources to record them live or let the stream start and stop drive it, split a session into game folders without stopping, and get a session.json manifest listing every file's exact start offset for editing in DaVinci Resolve.
